name: view-membership-live-rebind

k = d.keys()
v = d.values()
i = d.items()
print('a' in k, 1 in v, ('a',1) in i)
d['a'] = 7
d['b'] = 2
print('b' in k, 1 not in v, ('a',7) in i, ('b',7) not in i)
d = {'z':9}

name: view-membership-side-effects
code:
d = {'a':1}
k = d.keys()
log = []
def left():
    log.append('left')
    d['b'] = 2
    return 'b'
def right():
    log.append('right')
    return k
print(left() in right(), log)
